references.text: Describes the fulfillment of the command in verse 8, where the priests with the ark stand in the Jordan while the water stops
Refers back to the priests who stood in the Jordan with the ark of the covenant, as commanded in 3:8
Earlier instruction to follow the ark of the covenant carried by Levitical priests
Parallel event where Moses parted the waters of the Red Sea, a precursor to the parting of the Jordan
Instruction on how the Levites were to carry the ark of the covenant
Moses gave the law to the priests who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant
The priests carry the ark of the covenant at the conquest of Jericho, the same service as at the Jordan
Hebrews mentions the role of faith in crossing the water, which includes the crossing of the Jordan
